g.text: Instagram HLD: One Event, Two Async Consumers, One Hybrid Read Path
Kafka's post-created event drives both transcoding and fan-out; celebrity follows skip fan-out-on-write entirely
3. hybrid merge: pre-computed feed + celebrity posts read live
FAN-OUT HYBRID: normal accounts get fan-out-on-write -- the Fan-out Worker pre-computes each follower's feed_store entry.
Celebrity accounts (millions of followers) are exempted -- Feed Service merges their posts in at read time instead, straight from Core DB.
This avoids one upload fanning out into tens of millions of feed_store writes.
